OWNER DECISION — APPROVED: NARROW CI QUALIFICATION EXCEPTION
I authorise the existing .github/workflows/native.yml qualification pipeline, including its disposable one-day test-signing certificate and temporary downloadable CI installer/ZIP artifacts.
This authorisation applies to PR #85 qualification and the corresponding normal post-merge native CI runs.
Conditions:
- Test signing is permitted exclusively on disposable GitHub-hosted runners, using non-exportable, temporary certificates with verified cleanup.
- Production signing certificates and credentials remain prohibited.
- Existing unsigned installer/ZIP fixtures may be uploaded as GitHub Actions artifacts, with a maximum retention of 14 days.
- Public accessibility of these temporary CI artifacts is explicitly acknowledged and accepted.
- Artifacts must contain no secrets, personal data, private source archives or production credentials.
- These artifacts are test outputs, not official releases or certified production binaries.
- No GitHub Releases, tags, production signing, deployments, updater publication or additional distribution channels are authorised.
- No expansion beyond the existing CI artifact scope without separate approval.
- All mandatory checks, provenance requirements, rights restrictions and performance gates remain unchanged.
Continue V2 activation, independent review, scoped PR publication and all mandatory CI checks autonomously.
Normal integration into develop remains authorised only after every required gate passes. Do not request further approval for routine CI execution within this exception.
